summary: TYPE_COLOR.source='#00ff88' (= --grn, admission-green) is applied to all source-type orbital nodes regardless of state. Three source nodes exist: s1 (helen2027.html, state=dirty), s2 (temple.html, state=live), s3 (focus.html, state=live). None is SA_ADMITTED. Yet both orbital canvas (L347) and stream sidebar si-dot (L459) render them in --grn via TYPE_COLOR. Result: dirty and live source files visually read as 'admitted' in two render paths simultaneously. The si-state label text correctly shows .si-state.dirty→red and .si-state.live→--grn, but the si-dot and orbital node (type-color) override with --grn regardless. Compound signal: orbit node = green (ADMITTED), state text = 'dirty' (RED) — contradictory. Proposed tweak: TYPE_COLOR.source → rgba(255,255,255,.65) (dim-white / observed-neutral), distinct from admission-green and all existing type colors (claim=--mg, memory=--cy, task=--amb, skill=--pur).

A state=dirty source node signals ADMITTED (green dot/orbital) while simultaneously signaling DIRTY (red label text), creating contradictory governance semantics in one rendered row.
